policy.rule: 构建产物、运行时 checkout、分发 artifact 只能来自 .dependencies/pinned/；.dependencies/eval/ 存放待评估的新 ref，经兼容性评估后走 repin 流程转入 pinned/。context/ 仅作只读接口参考，不得作为执行依赖。
policy.repinRequired: pinned/ 下任何 ref 变更必须经 [业主] 批准的 repin 流程，并同步本文件。
policy.evalLifecycle: eval/<name> 评估完成后：(a) 通过则 repin 进 pinned/；(b) 不通过则保留或删除，理由记录在本文件 notes。
policy.upstreamSource: Upstream pins are byte-for-byte official source. Never edit or cherry-pick local changes into a pin; local behavior belongs in DNLS/DNK driver, adapter or overlay. Each repin reviews those adaptations and runs targeted compatibility experiments, not a release gate.
